title: DOST to showcase new agri-aqua technologies at 2026 NSTW
summary: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Science and Technology (DOST) will showcase three agricultural and aquaculture innovations at the 2026 National Science, Technology, and Innovation Week (NSTW)…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Science and Technology (DOST) will showcase three agricultural and aquaculture innovations at the 2026 National Science, Technology, and Innovation Week (NSTW) in General Santos City, on November 25–29.
The annual NSTW serves as a platform for presenting locally developed technologies and research initiatives that highlight the country’s scientific and technological progress.
Sun Harvest: A smart solar-powered irrigation system
Developed by DOST-Central Luzon, Sun Harvest is a mobile, solar-powered irrigation unit that provides an alternative to diesel and gasoline powered pumps.
It also provides an alternative water source for farmers, particularly those in remote areas with limited access to electricity.

Smart RAS: An aquaculture monitoring system

Designed by DOST-Metals Industry Research and Development Center (MIRDC), the Smart Recirculating Aquaculture System (RAS) uses Internet of Things (IoT) technology to monitor and regulate pond water quality in real time.

It tracks critical parameters such as ammonia, pH, temperature, salinity, and dissolved oxygen to maintain suitable conditions for aquatic species, including tilapia, shrimp, and soft-shelled crabs, while improving production efficiency.
Project ARKA: A streamlined agri-venture platform

For the agricultural sector, DOST-Central Visayas developed the Ark of Agriculture (ARKA), a technology-driven platform that connects farms directly to markets while improving agricultural production and distribution.
The platform uses IoT sensors from DOST’s Project SARAI to monitor soil moisture, temperature, and microclimate conditions, helping farmers optimize their use of water, fertilizers, and pesticides.
These innovations will be featured under the Wealth Creation Pillar of the Science and Technology Exhibit at the Gaisano Mall. (By David Buenaventura, Intern)
